title: Explained: What Sebi’s proposed CAS changes mean for expiry-day trading and settlement
text: Explained: What Sebi’s proposed CAS changes mean for expiry-day trading and settlement. The regulator has proposed two options for determining expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives, changes to the timing of the continuous trading session (CTS), CAS and derivatives trading, and additional measures aimed at improving the functioning of the auction.
